subject: Draft MAP & pricing ask — Nimble.ai discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimble.ai>, Chris Park <chris.park@nimble.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery + draft MAP (next steps)

Hi Elena / Chris — thanks again for today's call. Short recap and attached draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and owners so we can align on timeline: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Primary use case: low-latency document summarization for customer support (avg doc length ~3k tokens)
- Required: VPC deployment, SOC2 evidence, data residency in US region, 99th pctl latency target ~1200ms
- Pilot ask: 60-day pilot with instrumented evals and success criteria

Draft MAP (attached: 20270910_Nimble_MAP_v1.xlsx) — high-level milestones
1) Pilot kickoff (owner: Nimble engineering) — target: 2027-09-20
2) Integration & infra setup (owner: Redwood infra eng) — target: 2027-09-27
3) Instrumentation + evals (owner: Nimble analytics) — target: 2027-10-15
4) Pilot review & conversion decision (owner: Nimble + Redwood AE) — target: 2027-11-15

Dependencies / blockers
- Procurement needs SOC2 attestation + retention policy details (we can share SOC2 kit next business day)
- Pilot capacity: recommended reserved commit to guarantee latency while we instrument (we need to agree on commit level)

Pricing / commercial ask (initial ask from Nimble in call)
- Request: pilot credits and a discount tied to a 12-month commit if they convert after pilot

Next steps
- Elena / Chris to confirm owners and pilot kickoff date (reply inline)
- Redwood to send SOC2 evidence and updated MAP with pricing scenarios by Tue 2027-09-13 (attached: MAP v1)

Attachments: [20270910_Nimble_MAP_v1.xlsx] (Excel, MAP milestones)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimble.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Park <chris.park@nimble.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 09:21:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + draft MAP (next steps)

Hi Priyom — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Pilot length: we prefer 60 days but we need the ability to extend by 30 days if integration work runs long. Fine if the MAP captures a 60–90 day window.
2) Procurement asks: SOC2 plus data retention policy (we store PII for 30 days in staging, must be able to set TTL). Can you confirm Redwood's default retention and support for TTL on logs?
3) Credits/discounts: procurement will need to see a formal commercial proposal. High level — we're evaluating two vendors; competitive pricing and a pilot credit help our internal recommendation.
4) Commit level: for production we expect to start with a 12-month commit after pilot; estimate first-year egress/usage of ~4M tokens/month. We will confirm exact numbers after instrumentation.

I'll loop in procurement once we have the MAP+proposal. Pilot kickoff target depends on the SOC2 package and a short legal review.

Best,
Elena
Head of ML Products | Nimble.ai
elena.rossi@nimble.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Nimble MAP — pricing & exec approval request (need guidance)

Team — forwarding the customer thread and MAP. Key points and ask below.

Customer summary
- Nimble.ai wants a 60-day pilot (option to extend to 90 days) and has procurement requirements (SOC2 + TTL controls).
- They signaled intent for a 12-month commit post-pilot ~4M tokens/month if pilot meets SLOs.

Proposed commercial construct (attached: redwood_proposal_nimble_v2.pdf)
- Pilot: 60 days with $30k pilot credit (covers infra while we instrument).
- If they convert to a 12-month committed term within 45 days of pilot completion, offer: 10% discount on committed tier for year 1 + $30k conversion credit applied to first invoice.
- Commit levels/options:
  A) Commit 4M tokens/month — list price $X/month — recommended 10% off + $30k credit
  B) Commit 6M tokens/month — list price $Y/month — recommended 12% off + $45k credit (requires exec approval)

Rationale for ask
- Competitive sales cycle: competitor A is offering a similar pilot credit and aggressive first-year discounts; Nimble has vendor comparisons ongoing.
- We believe pilot instrumentation will demonstrate performance advantage and justify conversion.

Ask
1) Approve the proposed standard construct (Pilot $30k credit + 10% / $30k conversion credit) so I can respond to procurement with a formal commercial offer.
2) If we want to push for the larger commit construct (option B), I need exec signoff for the additional discount/credit.

Timing
- Customer expects proposal and SOC2 by Tue 2027-09-13 (we can deliver SOC2 kit today).
- Target close: 2027-10-15 (assumes pilot -> conversion cadence)

Attachments: [redwood_proposal_nimble_v2.pdf] (PDF, commercial scenarios)

Thanks — Priyom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Nimble MAP — pricing & exec approval request (need guidance)

Priyom — thanks for the summary and proposal. I reviewed the numbers and talked briefly with finance. Quick decision below.

Decision (approved)
- Approve the standard commercial construct: Pilot credit $30k + 10% discount on the 12-month committed tier + $30k conversion credit for commit of 4M tokens/month.
- Do NOT approve option B (6M commit with larger credit) without a stronger conversion guarantee; if the AE wants to pursue, escalate to VP Sales for one-off approval.

Conditions / next steps
- Legal must sign off on SOW language on credits and termination; please route to contracts and mark the conversion credit conditional on execution of SOW within 45 days post-pilot.
- Instrumentation checklist: ensure the pilot includes latency dashboards and regression alerting (assign to our solutions engineer).
- Priyom: send formal proposal + SOC2 kit to Elena and procurement now; capture procurement contact in HubSpot.

If Nimble asks for a larger upfront concession after procurement review, escalate immediately and include metrics from pilot instrumentation.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
